title: Argentinian Beef Skewers
description: Grilled beef skewers with a mix of vegetables, inspired by traditional Argentinian cuisine. Perfect for a quick and flavorful dinner.

ingredients.name: 1.5 pounds beef (skewer-friendly cut)
ingredients.notes: such as flank steak or sirloin

instructions: Thread beef, onion, bell peppers, and garlic onto skewers.
In a small bowl, mix together oregano, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the beef and vegetables.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the beef reaches 135°F (57°C) for medium-rare.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
